versions.content: Timing Variants Type: valid Description: The System Template shall provide the means to describe alternative timing properties (e.g. trigger type, period, priority) and timing constraints (e.g. latency, age). Rationale: Due to a different software-to-ECU mapping the timing properties and constraints for the transmission of signals can vary. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: A PDU is transmitted cyclically for two different product variants HIGH and LOW with a period of 10ms for the variant HIGH and 20ms for the variant LOW. Supporting Material: 
